# function: fqdn

Appends a trailing dot if absent, which is the form PowerDNS stores and the form its ids take.

```terraform
provider::powerdns::fqdn("example.com")  # "example.com."
provider::powerdns::fqdn("example.com.") # "example.com."
```

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Appends the trailing dot PowerDNS stores, so a variable can be written either
# way without the configuration caring.
output "qualified" {
  value = provider::powerdns::fqdn("example.com") # "example.com."
}
```

## Signature

<!-- signature generated by tfplugindocs -->
```text
fqdn(name string) string
```

## Arguments

<!-- arguments generated by tfplugindocs -->
1. `name` (String) The name to qualify.
